rules: Amounts are integer pesos. null means the version has no such line, never zero.
The NEP and the House bill are two versions of one budget: compare them, never add them. Sums over a filtered set are given per version and marked not_additive_across_versions.

Pairings are candidates: leads for checking, not confirmed changes. A line found in one version only is an insertion candidate (House bill only) or a deletion candidate (NEP only), never a confirmed insertion or deletion.

Unconfirmed matches (held: fuzzy or ambiguous pairings) are flagged on every row. Bridge figures are the stored ones the pages show: they include unconfirmed matches (fuzzy or ambiguous pairings, counted under 'In the House bill only'), so the six groups add up to net_php. Each group's unconfirmed_rows / unconfirmed_php is the unconfirmed part of it (non-zero only on DPWH house_only). php is the group's money basis: the House amount for house_only and unchanged, the NEP amount for nep_only, the size of the movement for increased and decreased, and the signed net for scope_review. The largest-rows lists leave unconfirmed matches out.

District figures carry their tier. A shared (Tier B) office's money is never divided between the districts it serves, and money under the DPWH Central Office and regional offices, which is on no district card, is returned as the residual.
Rows with a page on the site carry url; document page references carry pdf_url, which opens the source PDF at that page.

Every response carries disclaimers (id, title, body, url): the no-allegations paragraph everywhere, and the office-and-district paragraph as well on office-based views (the district routes and DPWH project lists filtered to one office). Keep them with any figure you republish.

nep.meaning: National Expenditure Program: the budget the President submits to Congress each August.

hgab.meaning: The House of Representatives' version of the budget, House Bill 10858 for 2027. It goes to the Senate next.

reading.meaning: The House votes on a bill twice. The third-reading text is the version it sends to the Senate.

pap.meaning: A heading in the budget under which projects are listed, for example 'Preventive Maintenance - Primary Roads'.

deo.meaning: The DPWH field office that carries out projects in an area. One office can serve more than one congressional district.

fap.meaning: A project paid for partly with a loan or grant from abroad.

candidate.meaning: A match or a gap found by comparing project names, places and amounts. It is a lead for checking, not a confirmed change.

tier.meaning: Tier A: the office serves one district, so its figure can be read as that district’s. Tier B: the office serves several districts, so the figure is shared and is not split between them.

residual.meaning: Money listed under the DPWH Central Office or a regional office. It does not appear on any district card.

stages.meaning: The NEP and the House bill are two versions of the same budget. Compare them; never add them together.

disclaimers.title: Office and legislative-district associations.
disclaimers.body: The DEO mapping associates offices with legislative districts; it does not establish that a representative requested, sponsored, or controlled a project, or that each project lies in every district associated with its office. Shared-office totals remain undivided and must not be split among the districts served. Office-based views must retain attribution tiers, co-served districts, unattributable residuals, and upstream uncertainty annotations. Historical or undated amounts retained as mapping evidence are separate from the FY2027 project ledger and must not be quoted as FY2027 allocations. See the DEO mapping restrictions.

office_change.note: Paired lines naming this office on one side and a different office group (or no district office) on the other. They are held out of the office's district-card figures and counted in the FY2027 House bill residual (office_change_php); those printed under this office are still among this list's rows and sums.

office_lens.tier_meaning: Tier A: the office serves one district, so its figure can be read as that district’s. Tier B: the office serves several districts, so the figure is shared and is not split between them.
office_lens.note: These are the rows the documents print under this office. The office is associated with the districts listed; no row is assigned to any one of them, and a Tier B office's sums are never split between its districts. Lines in office_change (their NEP and House bill sides name different offices) and in no_office are held out of the office's district-card figures. Money on no district card is the residual in the districts list.

annotations.note: The source's own uncertainty markers on this office's 2027 rows, kept apart rather than folded into the totals' reading. unconfirmed_rows / unconfirmed_php: unconfirmed (fuzzy or ambiguous) matches, counted under 'In the House bill only' and included in hgab3_php. scope_review_rows: a different stretch of the same road, not counted as a change. reading_markers: rows by their second-to-third-reading status. office_change.note: Paired lines held out of this office's figures because the NEP and House bill sides name different office groups, or one side names no district office. scope.fy2026_gaa_php: The enacted budget (GAA): the law Congress passed and the President signed for that year. Covers the whole office.
scope.fy2027_nep_php: The NEP: the budget the President submits to Congress each August. Covers the whole office.
scope.fy2027_hgab3_php: The House bill (third reading): the House of Representatives’ version of the 2027 budget, not yet law. Covers named projects only, so it is smaller than the whole-office figures; use fy2027_vs_proposal for a like-for-like change.

fy2027_vs_proposal.note: The 2027 House bill against the NEP on the same project rows of the serving offices (named projects only). This, not the headline pair, is the like-for-like change; it is what sort=change ranks on.

data.residual_note: Every year's DPWH total split into money under offices that appear on a district card (deo_php) and money on no district card: the Central Office, regional offices, and office names that matched nothing (not_on_any_district_php). Nine slots: FY2020–2026 enacted, FY2027 NEP, FY2027 House bill. For the FY2027 House bill only (0 for the enacted years and the NEP): no_office_php / no_office_rows are lines whose grouped records name no office (the source's no_office bucket). office_change_php / office_change_rows are paired lines whose NEP and House bill sides name different office groups (or one side names no district office). Both are held out of every office and every district card and counted in not_on_any_district_php. deo + central_office + regional_offices + unmatched + no_office + office_change = total.
